## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR (a new example and a doc fix are two PRs — see
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] Follows the rules every file in this repo follows: `YY-MM-DD` dates,
      one brain per group of related repos, one folder per repo, exactly
      one compact rollup per brain, a `README.md` in every brain and repo
      folder (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] If this PR touches `README.md`, `_templates/`, or `projects/`: a
      companion PR is open on
      [harness-stack](https://github.com/exponen-agi/harness-stack) copying
      the same files into `templates/brain/` (its CI checks the two stay
      byte-identical) — not needed for a docs-only fix like a typo
